svg.title: Adults reporting no physical activity in the past month: 40 large metro areas
svg.desc: One bar per metro area, from CDC SMART BRFSS 2023–2024. The same numbers are in the table on the page.
svg.text: Adults reporting no physical activity in the past month
40 large metro areas · CDC SMART BRFSS 2023–2024 · diogofit.com/learn/how-active-is-your-metro/
Bars sorted by the published estimate. Thin lines: the 95% confidence interval; two overlapping intervals are not meaningfully different.
No published figure for 8 large metro areas: Boston, Dallas, Detroit, New York, Philadelphia, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle.
Source: CDC, Selected Metropolitan Area Risk Trends (SMART) BRFSS, 2023 and 2024. Chart: Diogo Fitness,
https://diogofit.com/learn/how-active-is-your-metro/ (free to reuse with a link back; the data are the agency's).
